predecessors.name: Great Seljuk Empire
predecessors.text: Erzincan with Kemah, Divriği and Şebinkarahisar: the four regions the page names

ledger.x: 1072: Mengüjek Gazi founds the principality after Manzikert.
ledger.cp: holder not named by the page

ledger.x: 1228: the Sultanate of Rum subjugates the Erzincan branch: 'The Erzincan branch was subjugated by the Sultanate of Rum in 1228.'
1228: Şebinkarahisar is closed with the Erzincan branch at confidence 1; no page opened says who held it or when it passed.
1277: the Ilkhanate ends the Divriği branch ('The Divriği branch was ended by the Ilkhanate in 1277'), the last Mengujekid holding.
1277: the Mengujekid dynasty ends with the Divriği branch.

wars.name: Rum subjugation of the Erzincan branch
wars.outcome: The Sultanate of Rum subjugated the Erzincan branch in 1228; the Erzincan page records the town's destruction in 1243 in fighting between Kaykhusraw II and the Mongols.

wars.name: Ilkhanid end of the Divriği branch
wars.outcome: The Ilkhanate ended the Divriği branch in 1277.

certainty.note: Four regions named without frontiers; discs round Divriği and Şebinkarahisar and the province of Erzincan are approximations.
